test_initial_program: run the test_initial_program function to verify initial_program.py executes and outputs valid JSON with params
test_evaluator: run the test_evaluator function to verify evaluator.py scores initial_program.py and returns a valid score
test_mlir_file: run the test_mlir_file function to verify the MLIR baseline attention file exists and contains expected content
